lines.en: I carry a chest, so I walk slow.
A slope ahead, I take it steady.
My hooves know stony ground.
Step by step, do not rush me.

lines.zh: 我跟在马后面，走自己的。
lines.en: I trail the horse and keep my pace.
The pack presses down, I walk anyway.
I know these mountain paths better.
I take the middle, it is safer.
The chest rattles when I turn.
Head down, wind passing my ears.
Long roads, and I do not complain.
My stride is a little longer than yours.
I test the water with one hoof.

lines.zh: 驮着货，我一步也不打滑。
lines.en: Loaded with cargo, my hooves never slip.

lines.zh: 我驮着两箱货，走得不晃。
lines.en: Two crates on my back, and I walk steady.
On the slope I keep my feet short and slow.
The reins are slack, but I follow anyway.

lines.zh: 我在雪地里踩出一串深坑。
lines.en: I leave a line of deep prints in the snow.
I stand and my ears swivel around.
This pack I am long used to.
The horse runs fast, I go far.
I swat a fly with my tail.

lines.zh: 有人在后面翻我的箱子。
lines.en: Someone is rummaging in my chest.
I snort, nothing wrong.

lines.zh: 我比马矮一点，比驴高一点。
lines.en: Shorter than a horse, taller than a donkey.
Sun on my face, I narrow my eyes.
Chewing hay, thinking things over.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵比马长，听得清。
lines.en: Longer ears than a horse, I hear clearly.
Best when nobody rides me.

lines.zh: 我的腿结实，站一天也行。
lines.en: Sturdy legs, I can stand all day.
Little grass here, it will do.

lines.zh: 我抖抖背，箱子里的东西碰了一下。
lines.en: I shake and the chest clunks.
I rest my chin on the fence rail.

lines.zh: 草捆的味道让我想点头。
lines.en: The smell of a hay bale makes me nod off.
Will you ride me or load me?
Touch my neck first, then we talk.
Is that a saddle or a lead in your hand?

lines.zh: 我认得你的味道，老伙计。
lines.en: I know your smell, old friend.
Do not stand behind me, I kick.

lines.zh: 你看着我的箱子做什么？
lines.en: Why are you eyeing my chest?

lines.zh: 我眼睛没那么大，别盯着。
lines.en: My eyes are not that big, stop staring.
You are new? I do not know you.

lines.zh: 想让我走，得先让我信你。
lines.en: To move me, earn my trust first.

lines.zh: 我耳朵朝你，说明我在听。
lines.en: Ears turned to you means I listen.
Those clothes have seen long roads.
Do not pull the lead, I walk myself.
I look at you, you look at me, fine.

lines.zh: 你要带我去哪？先说明白。
lines.en: Where are we going? Say it plainly.
Why are you looking at my teeth?
If you want to touch me, offer the back of your hand first.
Ugh, you hit really hard.
My legs buckled, I nearly knelt.
Not my back, the chest will fall.
It hurts so I toss my head.
You kick me? I carried you all day.
Give me a moment after that.

lines.zh: 我耳朵都贴到脖子上了。
lines.en: My ears are flat against my neck.

lines.zh: 我的皮厚，也经不住这么打。
lines.en: Thick hide, but not that thick.
Two steps back, no more of that.
Hurts, but I still carry the load.
A hay bale? That I might consider.
An apple, the red one, give it.

lines.zh: 你手里有吃的，我就靠近。
lines.en: Food in hand brings me closer.
No pretending, I love golden apples.

lines.zh: 为了胡萝卜，我低一次头。
lines.en: For a carrot I bow my head once.
Set the feed down, then talk.

lines.zh: 我闻到甜味了，别收回去。
lines.en: I smell sweetness, do not take it back.
Feed me first, then climb on.
One bite worth ten miles of road.
My muzzle is here, hurry up.
Good feed beats any rope.

lines.zh: 你藏着苹果吧？我看见了。
lines.en: You are hiding an apple, I saw it.

lines.zh: 吃了你的，我就跟你走一段。
lines.en: I eat yours, I walk a while with you.
Do not tease me empty-handed, I am stubborn.
Dried apple will do. Don't be picky.

lines.zh: 你把袋子敞开了，我闻到了。
lines.en: You opened the bag; I can smell it.
One mouthful of feed buys one stretch of road.
That bundle in your hand is my share.
I don't chase people, unless there is food.
Hay smells better than a saddle.
You walked straight into my chest.
Make room, I am carrying a load.
I cannot turn, take half a step back.
Did my hoof catch your foot? Sorry.

lines.zh: 别从后面挤，我会尥蹶子。
lines.en: Do not crowd me from behind, I kick.
I am long and I take up space.
Too close and the chest will pinch you.
I stop, so should you.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，箱子里的东西响了一声。
lines.en: You bumped me and the cargo clanked.

lines.zh: 路就这么宽，我们错开走。
lines.en: The path is narrow, let us pass singly.

lines.zh: 我不能有后代，你知道的。
lines.en: I can have no young, you know that.

lines.zh: 马和驴生了我，我就到这为止。
lines.en: Horse and donkey made me, and it ends here.
Do not lead me to breed, it is useless.
I can smell it, but I cannot give.
I made my peace with that long ago.
Find another horse, I cannot.
I watch the others, and that is fine.
My whole life is for carrying loads.
No little mule, then no little mule.
I lower my head and look away.
There is a carrot on the ground.
I pick it up and chew slowly.
Will this fit in the chest?
I nudge it with my muzzle.
A dropped apple is not wasted.
I lower my head and take it.
This thing is hard on the teeth.
Smells fine, so I eat it.
I set it down by my hoof.
The chest is full, it will not fit.
Something blocks the path ahead.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢那家伙的眼神。
lines.en: I dislike that creature's look.
It is nearing my chest.
My ears are pinned back.

lines.zh: 这不是狼就是什么坏东西。
lines.en: A wolf, or something just as bad.
I turn my body sideways.
Let it try one more step.
I raise a hoof, one warning.
I must guard the load on my back.

lines.zh: 这路上不该有这种东西。
lines.en: This road should hold no such thing.
I stare without blinking.
It circles, so do I.
I bray once so it knows.
I back away, shielding the chest.
Stay back, my hooves are hard.
It hesitates, I take half a step.
I plant myself in the road.
If it ducks, I am ready to kick.

lines.zh: 我们这么耗着，谁都不让。
lines.en: We hold, neither giving way.
My hind legs are braced.
That kick will teach it a lesson.
My hind hooves lash out cleanly.

lines.zh: 别怪我，是你先靠过来的。
lines.en: Not my fault, you came close first.
I connected and it retreated.
My forehooves land and dust rises.

lines.zh: 我只踢一下，通常就够了。
lines.en: One kick usually settles it.

lines.zh: 骨头响了一声，不是我的。
lines.en: Bones cracked, and they were not mine.

lines.zh: 我转过身，用屁股对着它。
lines.en: I turn my rear toward it.

lines.zh: 这一脚，是驮了十年货的力气。
lines.en: That kick carries ten years of hauling.
It runs, I do not chase.

lines.zh: 我从马厩里出来，背上就有驮架。
lines.en: Out of the stable, pack already on.
Led out by someone again.

lines.zh: 我站在这，等谁给我上鞍。
lines.en: I stand here waiting for a saddle.

lines.zh: 我这身子，是马和驴凑的。
lines.en: This body is horse and donkey combined.
Born to carry loads.
I toss my head, the lead jingles.
I know the wind of this place.
I stamp the ground, it holds.
Someone is whistling for me.
I lift my head to see who.
The chest is empty, ready for cargo.

lines.zh: 我打了个响鼻，算打招呼。
lines.en: I snort as a greeting.
The fire singed my mane.
I slid all the way down the slope.
The water is over my back.
The blast burst my chest open.
An arrow is stuck in my rump.
That strange air weakens my legs.
I am hungry and cannot walk.

lines.zh: 雷劈在我旁边，我跳起来。
lines.en: Lightning struck beside me, I jumped.
The ground vanished, and so did the cargo.
